logistics.format: Task-oriented hands-on practical exam covering OS hardening, infra-as-code compliance, vulnerability management, security automation; lifetime validity

recommended_certs.rationale: Practical DevSecOps positions CDE as the expert-level follow-on to CDP.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Hands-on hardening, infrastructure compliance and automation support professional DevSecOps delivery despite the two-year profile; limited independent recognition and training dependence do not substantiate the Expert title.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Practical hardening, IaC compliance, vulnerability management and automation support professional DevSecOps implementation. The two-year profile and limited outside recognition do not justify expert seniority solely from the credential name.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded practical covers hardening, IaC compliance, vulnerability management and automation beyond the base track. This supports professional delivery, but the two-year profile and limited independent recognition do not justify the Expert label.
